LisBon Flow Infrastructure (LFI)

Give recurring physical operations one operating truth.

Discuss a deployment↗See how it works ↓

LFI coordinates route-based work across operators, jobs, assets, locations, execution states and completion records. It gives transport, logistics, delivery and field-service organisations one authoritative view of what should move and what actually happened.

Who it is for

Transport, logistics and delivery businesses that want connected operations under their own brand.

See the work

The situation

Routes, jobs and field work are split across calls, messages, paper, spreadsheets and disconnected systems.

02

The system at work

LFI maintains the operating state behind scheduled work, assignments, execution, completion, exceptions and history.

03

The outcome

Managers and field teams see the same operation from the view appropriate to their role.

Agree what success looks like

Make the improvement visible.

Assignment clarity; execution visibility; completion evidence; exception time; reconciliation effort.

Measures are agreed for each deployment. They are not guaranteed results.
